sectionNotes.data: Organizations with their own CrowdStrike and LINE, the people who sign in, and whether the data is current
sectionNotes.system: The SOC's own LINE bot, CVE feeds, email and the audit log

drawer.tenants: Create an organization, then set its own CrowdStrike connections and its own LINE sources and groups.
drawer.team: Invite people and manage who can sign in.
drawer.line: The system's LINE connection and the SOC team's own chats. Not the organizations' chats.
drawer.falcon: The old CrowdStrike connection shared by several organizations. New organizations should use their own connection.

settings.legacyWarning: New organizations should use their own CrowdStrike connection in Organizations.

invite.description: They get a link to set a password and join. You can also email it to them.

mail.send: Also send the link by email
mail.noSender: No email sender is set up yet
mail.failed: The email could not be sent. Send the link below yourself.
mail.noSenderResult: No email sender is set up. Send the link below yourself.
mail.resetBody: Creates a one-time link for {email} to set a new password.
mail.regenerateBody: Creates a new link for {email}. The old link stops working.

line.title: LINE bot (system)
line.socNote: This is the system's LINE connection and the SOC team's own chats. Each organization's own groups are set in Organizations.
line.sourceTitle: SOC team chats that send news to the bot (checked against every organization)
line.sourceHelp: The bot reads only these chats and the organizations' own news chats. It reacts to links, CVE ids and pictures. To find a chat's ID, add the bot to it and type /chatid.
line.sourceEmpty: No SOC chat yet: the bot reads no SOC messages.
line.destTitle: SOC team chats that receive the alert summaries
line.destHelp: The bot sends every result, for all organizations, to each chat in this list. Use internal SOC groups, never a customer's group. The bot must be a member of each group.
line.destEmpty: No destination set: the bot answers in the chat the news came from.
line.orgHelp: Read only. Each organization's news chats and destination groups are set in Organizations. A group receives only its own organization's results.
line.orgEmpty: No organization has its own LINE chat yet.

errors.chat_taken: This chat already belongs to an organization. Remove it there first or use another chat.
